blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Butuan City’s emergency water rationing operations got a boost with the arrival of four newly-acquired water tankers on Wednesday, amid the continuing disruption in water supply affecting several communities. The additional fleet consists of two high-capacity tankers with a capacity of 20,000 liters each and two tankers capable of carrying 10,000 liters each, significantly increasing the city’s water delivery capacity. The tankers are currently undergoing leak testing and inspection of accessories and equipment to ensure they are safe and ready for deployment.
